item.title: About ALMACIR
item.description:
ALMACIR is an ANR project (ANR-25-CE27-2996), funded by the CNRS and hosted by the IRAMAT-CNRS laboratory, under the coordination of Sébastien Gasc .

The project aims to study Western medieval Islamic coinage. This website and the Numishare database are part of the Iramat-apps initiative.
